note: Adapted from Hill's (1942) species-level description, the original in English; the original combination is Glyptotermes tuberculatus Froggatt, 1896 (rendered in the OCR mostly as uuberoula-tus / tuberoulatus), the heading reading Calotermes (Glyptotermes) tuberoulatus (Froggatt). Measurements in mm. Distribution: Uralla, New South Wales (type locality), Kincumber, Minnamurra, Narrabeen, Woronora, Galston, Tomerong, Jervis Bay, Kowen, Eden; Auckland, New Zealand (introduced). The original records that the species occurs mostly in small colonies, in logs, near fire scars and in the sound wood of living Banksia and several Eucalyptus trees; alates were taken from 28 December to 21 January (month 12 to month 1). Type material: a soldier lectotype and an alate lectomorphotype in C.S.I.R. For the distinction from C. brevicornis see that entry: the alate differs in the more quadrate pronotum, and the soldier in the smaller size and the distinctly more developed projections on the anterior margin of the head.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: A small pale species, overall ochre, the postclypeus, antennae and legs slightly paler than the head, the main wing veins reddish brown. Head (Fig. 46) with very few hairs, the vertex flat and wrinkled. Compound eyes large, protruding. Antennae 15- or 16-segmented, usually 15. Pronotum with impressed margins, wider than the head, the anterior margin widely concave, the sides only slightly rounded and narrowed posteriorly, the posterior margin wide and slightly wavy, sparsely provided with a row of short and moderately long hairs. Measurements (mm): body length with wings 10.25—11.00; body length without wings 5.75—7.00; head length (to apex of labrum) 1.30—1.46; head length (to clypeofrontal suture) 1.02—1.06; head width 1.13—1.17; pronotum length 0.65—0.69; pronotum width 1.19—1.24; forewing length 8.50; forewing width 2.20.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head long, relatively wide for this subgenus, the anterior dorsal projection very well developed (Figs. 47, 48). Antennae 12- or 13-segmented, usually 13. Right mandible with 2 short median teeth; left mandible with 3 short teeth, the basal tooth slightly farther from the median tooth than the apical tooth is from the median tooth. Compound eyes degenerate. Measurements (mm): body length 5.50—7.00; head length including mandibles 2.27—2.68; head length (to clypeal suture) 1.76—2.09; head width 1.21—1.32; pronotum length 0.58—0.69; pronotum width 1.24—1.35.
